youtube.title: Packed structs for gRPC in the browser — grpc-over-datachannels v0.46.0
youtube.description:
v0.46.0 brings the packed DCS1 struct codec to JavaScript, Python, Lua, PHP, Ruby, and the Wasm builds of Swift, Dart, C++, Zig, Kotlin, and Scala. Protobuf stays the default; structs are opt-in per endpoint with dc-codec: struct-v1 negotiation.

Code: https://github.com/browser-grpc/grpc-over-datachannels
Release: https://github.com/browser-grpc/grpc-over-datachannels/releases/tag/v0.46.0
Blog: https://c100k.blogspot.com/2026/11/packed-structs-on-wire-now-in-browser.html
In-browser stub generator: https://browser-grpc.github.io/grpc-over-datachannels/app/

scenes.heading: Packed structs, now in the browser
scenes.sub: Cap'n-Proto-style gRPC, protobuf at the edges
scenes.say: What if gRPC had a faster wire format for the paths that need it? This release brings the packed struct codec to every browser language. Same gRPC, same data channel, less time spent encoding.

scenes.heading: Two codecs, one negotiation
bullets: Protobuf stays the default and the interop format
dc-codec: struct-v1 HEADERS opt-in per endpoint
Mismatch fails UNIMPLEMENTED, never silent fallback
scenes.say: Protobuf stays the default everywhere. At generation time you can opt a message into a packed struct layout: fixed slots, a presence bitmap, no tag-and-varint walk. Channels and servers opt in per endpoint, and a mismatch fails loudly instead of falling back.

scenes.heading: Now everywhere
bullets: JavaScript, Python, Lua, PHP, Ruby: pure transcoders
Swift, Dart, C++, Zig, Kotlin, Scala: real struct calls in Wasm
21 corpus drivers byte-identical to the Go golden
Proto2 shape locked: extensions ride the unknown tail
scenes.say: The browser implementations are pure descriptor-driven transcoders, so they work in Wasm too, where there is no native library to call. Twenty-one conformance drivers prove every implementation byte-identical, including a new proto2 shape.

scenes.heading: Also in 0.46
bullets: grpc-dart joins grpc-java and grpc-go as an interop oracle
Every suite now tests all three Google stacks, both directions
scenes.say: Also new: google's Dart gRPC runtime joins Java and Go as a third interop oracle, exercised in both directions by every language suite.
